_comment: Starter manifest — proves the pipeline on Buddy + the first two letters (A, D) already used in the design canvas. Extend the assets[] array to cover the rest of the alphabet before a full production run. tier 'pro' = gemini-3-pro-image-preview (best character consistency, ~$0.134/image at GA pricing, check current pricing before a big run). tier 'flash' = gemini-3.1-flash-image (cheaper, fine for simple single-object icons once the style is locked).

assets.prompt: Buddy the fox standing upright, one paw raised in a friendly wave, warm welcoming smile, looking at the viewer. This image becomes the character reference for every other Buddy pose — make it a clean, clear, neutral full-body view.
Buddy the fox cheering with both arms raised high, big delighted open-mouth smile, small motion lines around him suggesting excitement.
Buddy the fox mid-air jumping for joy, arms up, legs tucked slightly, a small soft shadow beneath him on the ground, joyful expression.
Buddy the fox with head tilted to one side, one ear perked up, curious and thoughtful expression, as if listening closely for a sound.
Buddy the fox mid-yawn, eyes half closed, one paw stretched up, sleepy and cozy expression.
Buddy the fox pointing off to one side with one paw, eyebrows raised, inviting the viewer to look that way.
